title: Construction Artifacts in Metaphor Identification Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on metaphor identification datasets using incomplete input baselines (e.g., hiding the context or masking the potential metaphorical expression) to detect whether models rely on spurious correlations rather than actual metaphoricity.
Comparing model performance across original, random, and lexical data splits to assess the impact of lexical memorization and non-natural distributions within the datasets.
